capabilities: Annotate a paragraph on hover or any text selection
Write comments inline with CriticMarkup syntax
Show comments in a Google-Docs-style margin with aligned cards
Add whole-document comments and optional comment prefixes
extras: The plugin UI is currently in Chinese. No default hotkey is set; one can be assigned in Settings → Hotkeys.
motivation: When revising an AI draft, describing where to change things in a chat box is slow and error-prone; annotating in place removes that ambiguity.
problem: Describing where to change an AI draft in a chat box is slow and ambiguous, since the AI cannot tell which passage a comment refers to.
summary: Annotation plugin that attaches review comments to selected Markdown text using CriticMarkup syntax so AI tools can revise drafts.
